messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated 5xx/timeouts seen across gateway -> egress to model-backend. Start time ~2026-03-15T10:05:22Z (ts 2478301122). Impacting ~10% of requests to /v1/generate and a small but growing number of customer sessions. Correlation IDs reported in sample logs: cid=8f2a7c, cid=8f2a8f. Auto-notify oncall.
Sam: ACK. I'm oncall for infra. first pass: are these 502 vs 504 or both? Any obvious upstream 5xx?
Leila: seeing mix: gateway 502 from `upstream_read_error`, and 504 timeouts on model-proxy. Hit rate for retries spiked. Will attach quick sample logs in a sec.
Dave: oncall link: /runbooks/runtime-timeout. I want the trace ids/corr ids to stitch traces. Sam can you collect kvlogs and short timeline? Priya please collect full logs for 10:04:30-10:09:30 UTC and put in shared GCS.
Priya: grabbing logs now. I will upload filtered bundle (gw logs + model-proxy + egress) -> gs://redwood-incident-logs/2478301122/ . Adding perms to incident-channel.
Sam: hypothesis 1: upstream model-backend started returning 5xx which triggered gateway retries and then thundering retry amplification into model-proxy -> backlog -> timeouts. Hypothesis 2: network egress transient causing backend TCP resets. Need correlation ids to confirm retry origin.
Leila: shared sample tail of gateway log:
```
2026-03-15T10:05:18Z gw [info] req_id=8f2a7c path=/v1/generate upstream_status=502 upstream_error="upstream_read_error" retry_count=1
2026-03-15T10:05:20Z gw [warn] req_id=8f2a8f path=/v1/generate upstream_status=504 timeout_ms=30000
```
Leila: model-proxy snippet:
```
2026-03-15T10:05:19Z proxy [error] corr=8f2a7c upstream_conn_reset
2026-03-15T10:05:21Z proxy [info] corr=8f2a8f queue_time_ms=4500 processing_ms=25000
```
Dave: ok queue_time is high, processing_ms large -> backend slow or busy. Do we see a burst of retries from gateway? Sam?
Sam: yes, rate limiter counters show retry loop spikes at 10:05:18-10:05:30. Gateway retry policy is conservative but clients get 502 and gateway reissues once -> duplicates under load. I'll paste counters:
```
10:05:15 - 10:05:30
requests_total=1200
retries_issued=320
successful_after_retry=45
```
Priya: log bundle uploaded: gs://redwood-incident-logs/2478301122/ (files: gw.log.gz, proxy.log.gz, model-backend.log.gz). Shared with @here. Link: <https://storage.cloud/2478301122>
oncall-bot: Runbook step 1: enable emergency fallback route to model-variant-b (lower capacity) - execute if upstream error rate > 5% for 3m. Current upstream error rate 9%.
Leila: can we enable fallback now? It might reduce latency even if lower quality.
Sam: I'm fine enabling fallback as temporary mitigation. Executing canary route switch to variant-b -> sending command.
deploy-bot: Deploy request: switch-route -> model-variant-b; initiated by Sam; tracking id=deploy-2478301. Rolling change 2/3 hosts.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: switch-route completed on 2/3 hosts, remaining host draining.
Sam: mitigation status: after route switch, observed drop in 502s but some lingering 504s. metrics (10:06:00 - 10:08:00): error_rate now 3.2%, p95 latency dropped 800ms -> 350ms.
Priya: while mitigation helped, root cause still unknown. Extracting model-backend logs.
Leila: model-backend shows GC/RT spike around 10:05:16-10:05:28 on a subset of hosts: sample:
```
2026-03-15T10:05:17Z backend-3 [warn] gc_pause_ms=3100 memory_free=120MB
2026-03-15T10:05:18Z backend-3 [error] conn_reset_by_peer
2026-03-15T10:05:20Z backend-3 [info] processed_request_ms=28000
```
Dave: GC pause + processing_ms high aligns with backlog -> upstream timed out -> gateway retries. Looks like a hot subset of model hosts ran long GC/processing. Maybe a bad model shard or caching cold start.
Sam: tracking hypothesis matrix in-thread:
- H1: model-backend GC spike causes timeouts -> gateway retries -> amplification. Evidence: backend GC logs, processing_ms high. (supporting: yes)
- H2: network egress transient causing resets. Evidence: some conn_reset entries, but not system-wide (mixed). (supporting: weak)
- H3: recent rollout introduced a slower kernel on a shard. Evidence: check recent deploys around 10:00. (supporting: unknown)
Priya: I checked deploy history: no deploys to model-backend in past 2h. There was a config tweak to memory tuning at 08:00 but no immediate correlation.
Leila: can we correlate corr ids to customers? I see two customer-facing sessions with corr 8f2a7c and 8f2a8f — both affected user sessions with active requests.
Sam: action items for immediate RCA: 1) collect heap/GC dumps from backend-3, backend-4 for 10:04-10:07 window. 2) export pprof CPU/heap if available. 3) check network interface errors on egress hosts. 4) run a targeted replay of affected requests against variant-b to confirm latency difference.
Dave: assigning self to network check. Priya take heap extraction. Leila collect correlation mapping to customers and attach by EOD. Sam will assemble timeline.
Priya: heap dumps uploaded -> gs://redwood-incident-logs/2478301122/heap_dumps/. Note size ~ 1.2GB. Will redact keys.
Sam: timeline so far:
- 10:04:50 - brief increase in incoming QPS
- 10:05:16 - backend-3 GC spike starts
- 10:05:18 - gateway records first 502 (req 8f2a7c)
- 10:05:19 - gateway issues retries -> spikes retries_issued
- 10:05:21 - model-proxy queue increases, processing latency grows
- 10:06:05 - route switch to variant-b initiated
- 10:06:40 - errors fall to baseline

Sam: tentative root cause: transient GC/processing spike on a subset of model-backend hosts causing upstream timeouts and retry amplification at gateway. Next: full RCA to confirm why GC spike occurred (heap pressure, workload burst, or kernel change).
Leila: customer impact: two paying customers observed degraded responses for 2-3 minutes. No data loss. Notifying CS to reach out with incident note.
Dave: network check done: no broad egress link errors, interface counters clean. So deprioritize H2.
oncall-bot: Incident severity lowered to S2 due to mitigation and limited customer impact. Please file postmortem and assign owner.
Sam: assigning postmortem owner: Priya. Priya can you own the RCA and followups?
Priya: will own RCA. Will include timeline, heap analysis, and followups (heap tuning, alerting for GC pauses, retry backoff review).
Sam: followups list (quick):
- alert: create an alert for GC pause > 2s on model hosts (owner: Priya)
- retry policy: review gateway retry amplification under partial upstream failure (owner: Sam)
- route-fallback: add automatic fallback if upstream_error_rate > 7% for 2m (owner: Leila)
- postmortem due: 48h (owner: Priya)

Priya: noted. I'll start drafting the postmortem and share initial report link: https://docs.redwood.com/incident/2478301122
Sam: thanks all. Closing this thread for active mitigation. If new evidence emerges, reopen thread or create follow-up. :thumbsup:
